findings.title: Background reader thread in createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti is never joined or guaranteed to stop
findings.body: In `createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti`, the background thread that repeatedly calls `managedRealm.admin().groups().groups(null, 0, Integer.MAX_VALUE, true)` is started with `new Thread(...).start()` without saving the `Thread` reference or calling `join()` before `assertThat(caughtExceptions, Matchers.empty())`, and `deletedAll.set(true)` is not placed in a `finally` block. As a result, an in-flight `groups(...)` request that fails after `deletedAll.set(true)` will record its exception in `caughtExceptions` after the assertion has already run (masking the failure) and may still be executing while subsequent tests run against `managedRealm`. In addition, if any `remove()` call throws an exception, `deletedAll` is never set to `true` and the background thread will spin indefinitely for the rest of the test suite.
